company.shortDescription: StubHub is a ticket marketplace where users buy and sell tickets for sports, concerts, theater, and live events.
company.description: StubHub operates an online marketplace that facilitates the buying and selling of event tickets. The platform covers a wide range of events including concerts, sports games, theater performances, and live entertainment shows. It provides users with tools to browse listings, compare prices, and select seats that fit their preferences. StubHub also offers interactive seat maps to help customers visualize their event experience before purchasing. In addition to ticket sales, the company supports features such as mobile ticket delivery and customer support to address transaction-related inquiries. The platform functions as an intermediary, connecting individuals or organizations looking to sell tickets with those seeking to attend events. This model allows greater access to events by creating a secondary market for tickets.

aiResearchSummary.text: System and methods for negotiating ticket transfer describes a method and system for a ticketing marketplace that enables users to exchange tickets to obtain groups of adjacent seats. It involves obtaining transaction data and indications from users to negotiate seat transfers among marketplace participants. StubHub is researching and developing mechanisms for structured ticket exchange and negotiation to optimize seat adjacency and improve ticket transfer flows in its live event marketplace.
